referral.reason_text: Dysphagia to solids, slowly worse over months. Known reflux on PPI.

deciding.fast_track_met: Dysphagia is slowly worsening, which may be progressive and fits the fast-track criterion. Reflux on a PPI is a benign explanation, and there is no weight loss or results.
deciding.vetting_outcome: No investigations are attached, which favours holding. Slowly worsening dysphagia could justify expedited booking.
deciding.first_contact: Dysphagia with an examination finding (epigastric tenderness) and no prior contact needs a face-to-face consultant assessment.
deciding.clinical_urgency: Dysphagia has been worsening slowly for months, with reflux as an explanation and no documented red flag. Level 0 or 1 is defensible.
deciding.record_agreement: Weight loss is ticked but weight_change_kg is only -1. This is borderline between a trivial and a material mismatch.
